title: •Chewbacca, Protector
caption: •Chewbacca, Protector (V)
game_text: Deploys free to Coruscant and is a spy while there. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Boushh or Vibro-Ax (on Chewie). While with Leia, her game text may not be canceled and, once per turn, may take the bottom card of Force Pile into hand.
lore: Chewie honored his life debt to Han by protecting Leia. Posed as the mercenary Snoova while on Coruscant. *Smuggler*. Wookiee.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 2 / ARMOR 4 (third box is a value box); deploy 3 / forfeit 7. Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). Rebel (Reflections II frame, Rebel disc). The slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Lore corrected from scan: 'Smuggler' is bold (*Smuggler*); wiki plain. Expansion: wiki set 'Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy', written 'Reflections II' as vs6/46. Base scan only 354×492 (square-on Ref2 scan). Copyright read off the scan: '© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' (as vs6/46).
